artifacts.notes: The full mixed-rights archive is identified and hashed but not retained. The tracked lemma projection contains no SBLGNT surface-text column.
artifacts.rights_basis: MorphGNT's morphological parsing and lemmatization are offered under CC BY-SA 3.0. The archive also embeds SBLGNT surface text governed by the separate SBLGNT text license; the MorphGNT license does not relicense that text.

artifacts.notes: One lemma occupies each physical line. Raw-line literal case-sensitive searches therefore replay exact lemma-token counts without distributing the SBLGNT surface text.
artifacts.rights_basis: This projection retains only MorphGNT's lemma field, whose parsing and lemmatization are distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0; it omits the separately licensed SBLGNT surface-text fields.
